searchText: Quiz question: an account has no balance, 0 nonce, no code but storage. Is it considered "empty"? If considered empty, does it mean when touched it will be deleted? Can the EIP-2930+ transaction have chain_id 0? Does it have special meaning? No, not per spec at least. There was discussion around making 0 mean any chain, but people didn't like it. If you want to find out why, first place to check would be 2930 or 1559 EIP rationale sections. Not sure if it is there, but it is where I would start. Thanks, but I'm only asking from the implementation perspective We need an LLM fine tuned on all EIPs so questions like this can be answered quickly. 🤔 There is one actually Link? Would it have answered this question correctly? Let me see if I can find it. https://chatgpt.com/g/g-ql5AZHYWX-eip-expert This is a Peter Davies question, but I don't know their Discord handle. Do you <@689161464829050960>? <@243183686562873344> (He changed his last name) Empty accounts with storage can be cleared by touching. There were over 100 of them because they were quite easy to accidently create before Homestead. They have all been deleted.
